answer: Agents bind identity to directional RF link fingerprints and stake-backed state estimates, so a sybil must whisper across many hops before its prism of pseudonyms aligns with a single physical emitter. Peers weight each claim by a shale-like layered reputation ledger, forcing colluders to fracture stake across redundant topologies that consensus deconfliction then collapses. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
